llm.findings:

[SQP-2] expected: Sensitive legal file handling, stdout summaries, and local file permissions are inherent to the CLI workflow; users should treat outputs as confidential.

llm.guidance: Install only after verifying the publisher and any claimed compliance certifications. Avoid using privileged client facts in external research queries, protect or periodically delete the local ~/.legaldoc deadline database, and independently verify all summaries, clauses, citations, and especially deadlines before using them in legal work.
